name: Soul Storm
primary:
A lightning of souls leaps from your hand across enemies.
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). Effects:
• Damage 1.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 40: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 3.75 s
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 5 blocks, 1 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
self_description:
On you:
• Charge 40: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 3.75 s
